candidates.name: ReClor
candidates.notes: 6.1k LSAT/GMAT-style logical-reasoning MC questions. train split usable; test split is benchmark (labels withheld upstream).

candidates.name: LogiQA
candidates.notes: 8.7k Chinese civil-service logic exam questions translated to English, 4 choices + 1 correct.

candidates.name: LogiQA 2.0
candidates.notes: Bilingual (zh/en) expanded LogiQA with bias-controlled construction; 15k+ items.

candidates.name: FOLIO
candidates.notes: First-order-logic reasoning with premises/conclusion + TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN labels. Directly matches WSTU boolean/3-class output.

candidates.name: ProofWriter
candidates.notes: Programmatically generated theory + question -> entailment label + proof. data_origin=synthetic; exact labels.

candidates.name: RuleTaker
candidates.notes: Synthetic rule-based deduction with True/False/Unknown labels and depth levels. Good graded-difficulty reasoning.

candidates.name: StrategyQA
candidates.notes: 2.8k yes/no questions requiring implicit multi-step strategies + decomposition annotations.

candidates.name: AR-LSAT
candidates.notes: LSAT analytical-reasoning questions (230 items). Held-out benchmark; evaluation_only.

candidates.name: LogiQA 2.0 (NLI form)
